title: Attachment and development
learning_outcomes: Explain attachment research in the context of attachment and development.
Compare and distinguish development in the context of attachment and development.
Apply label limitations in the context of attachment and development.
Evaluate and justify decisions about responsive communication in the context of attachment and development.

lessons.title: Attachment research
lessons.outcome: Explain attachment research in the context of attachment and development.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving attachment research; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to attachment case critique.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain attachment research from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of attachment research; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Development
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish development in the context of attachment and development.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving development; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to attachment case critique.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain development from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of development; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Label limitations
lessons.outcome: Apply label limitations in the context of attachment and development.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving label limitations; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to attachment case critique.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain label limitations from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of label limitations; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Responsive communication
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about responsive communication in the context of attachment and development.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving responsive communication; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to attachment case critique.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain responsive communication from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of responsive communication; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of attachment research; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of development; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of label limitations; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of responsive communication; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
